essence: The guru should perform the oblation together with the lords of the true form.
Śamyā, apāmarga, śrīvṛkṣa, pippala and other known woods are suitable.
The worship of the pot and fire should be completed on the second day.
When the auspicious moment arrives, one should perform the placement of mantras.
Whatever is not stated here should be done according to the general rules of installation.
